# Immune Branch

The fastest personalized loop today: neoantigen mRNA/peptide vaccines (mRNA-4157, autogene cevumeran), adoptive cell therapy (CAR-T/TCR-T/TIL), and off-the-shelf engagers (BiTE/ICI). Computable: somatic variants, HLA, binding/presentation, mRNA construct design (delegated to mrna-design). Empirical: immunogenicity, off-tumor toxicity, persistence/trafficking, response of "cold" tumors. Rate-limited by neoantigen immunogenicity (see [walls/index.md](../../walls/index.md)).
